This is one technical sprite atlas: each icon must be centred precisely within its own cell, fully contained inside that cell with 55 pixels of empty transparent padding on all sides. Keep the spaces between cells completely transparent. Each object occupies a comparable readable 360 to 400 pixel extent and must never touch another cell.
Subjects in strict reading order:
Top-left cell (centre 256,256): one worn field helmet, warm sand-painted composite shell, exposed dark steel fasteners, tan padded rim, small practical mount, three-quarter product view with the front visible. No head inside.
Top-middle cell (centre 768,256): one chest armour vest, stitched tan canvas carrier with separate weathered steel and sand-coloured protective plates, straps and visible layered construction, three-quarter frontal product view. No body or sleeves.
Top-right cell (centre 1280,256): a pair of reinforced tan field gloves, five distinct fingers on each, darker grip surfaces and steel knuckle inserts, one glove upright and the other slightly angled behind, clearly a paired hand-wear item.
Bottom-left cell (centre 256,768): a pair of articulated leg armour assemblies with shaped thigh and shin plates, knee hinges, visible slim powered-assist rails and dark straps. Tan and worn steel, detached equipment with no person wearing it. Legs held together as one compact inventory icon.
Bottom-middle cell (centre 768,768): a pair of heavy practical desert field boots, tan leather and fabric, dark replaceable soles, reinforced toes and ankle seals, paired three-quarter product view.
Bottom-right cell (centre 1280,768): one neural targeting implant, a delicate curved palm-size metallic cranial lattice with a central ceramic processor, several short precise connector tendrils and a tiny restrained cyan status light. A sophisticated internal medical-electronic module, NOT a backpack, NOT a helmet, NOT a skull.

Soft neutral studio lighting from upper left, crisp silhouettes and readable highlights at 48-pixel display size. Fine believable functional wear at seams and joints rather than uniform grunge. Rich material detail, restrained realistic contrast.
Constraints: six icons only; strict equal square-cell alignment; genuine alpha transparency; preserve every silhouette; no human, no scene, no cast shadows outside the object, no checkerboard background, no floor, no text, no logos, no watermark.
